newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE index drops over 100 pts as Dow falls.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE index drops over 100 pts as Dow falls.

text.p: The UK's FTSE 100 index of blue chip stocks dropped more than 100 points at one stage on Friday as a sharp fall on Wall Street sent British shares lower, dealers said.

The UK index was down 99.8 points at 4,850.0 by 1448 GMT, after dropping as much as 100.7 points at one point. Decliners were in a near four-to-one majority, with sharp falls in bank stocks such as HSBC Holdings Plc helping propel the market decline.
The Dow was down some 114 points, dragged lower by frequently-volatile technology stocks after slightly disappointing earnings from Microsoft, which fell more than $7.
